glossEn: the products of human creativity; works of art collectively / the creation of beautiful or significant things
note: the products of human creativity; works of art / the creation of beautiful or significant things。线索：a work of art / fine arts。不可数时指这门创作活动。

glossEn: a superior skill that you can learn by study and practice and observation
note: a superior skill that you can learn by study and practice。线索：the art of doing sth / the art of negotiation。这是「art」的高频实际用法，比「美术」更常见。
